headline: Names a post office in Shelby, Indiana, after Richard Allen Cable.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 23323 Shelby Road in Shelby, Indiana, as the "Richard Allen Cable Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
